paper.title: Algorithm 790: CSHEP2D: Cubic Shepard method for bivariate interpolation of scattered data

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 790 shar: Fortran77/Drivers/Sp/driver1.f, src_792.f, data1, res1_2; Fortran77/Src/Sp/src.f)

claim.text: The Max Error for interpolation function 1, node set 1 (N=100, NI=33, NC=17, NW=30, NR=6), printed by CS2TST to res1_2, is 0.0451, as in the shipped reference output. Absolute tolerance 5e-5 (half of the last printed unit).

values.name: CS2TST node set 1, function 1, Max Error (4 decimal print)

attempt: Reproduced with a build-only patch. The archive ships no build command. The as-shipped driver1.f compiled alone fails to link (the external routines testdt and tstfn1 are in src_792.f, not in driver1.f; original attempt logged). The authors' driver1.f, src_792.f and src.f are compiled together, out of tree, with gfortran -O0 (no source edited; three manifests prove it: verify_sources record build-only, nothing modified, removed or added between pre and mid). The driver is fed the first six lines of data1 (node set 1: KS=1, functions 1 to 10, NC=17, NW=30, NR=6). Two clean passes both print Max Error 0.0451 for function 1, identical to the shipped res1_2 at the printed precision. The driver's full table is kept as evidence. Toolchain: gfortran from conda-forge in the sandbox scratch. Replay (G5) not yet run.

original_attempt.reason: driver1.f alone does not link: the routines it calls are in the other archive files (ld error); the archive has no build command
